mapper.select: SELECT sys90_my_screen_layout AS my_screen_layout , sys90_props AS props FROM sys90_user_props WHERE sys90_user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys90_user_props (sys90_user_id, sys90_company_id, sys90_my_screen_layout, sys90_reg_dt, sys90_upd_dt) VALUES (#{userId}, #{companyId}, #{json}, now(), now()) ON CONFLICT (sys90_user_id) DO UPDATE SET sys90_my_screen_layout = EXCLUDED.sys90_my_screen_layout , sys90_company_id = EXCLUDED.sys90_company_id , sys90_upd_dt = now()
